'''Swamp frogs''' are monsters found in the [[Lumbridge Swamp]], around the [[water altar]].

Players can kill them as a [[Slayer assignment]] when a [[Slayer Master]] assigns [[Frogs (Slayer assignment)|frogs]].

==Trivia==
* Prior to [[17 November]] [[2025]], they looked very similar to [[big frog]] and [[giant frog]], only smaller. Swamp frogs were released nearly 16 years after its larger counterparts, as part of an update to improve low-level Slayer; they have a lower combat level and roam in the open swamp rather than in the more dangerous [[Lumbridge Swamp Caves]].
* Swamp frogs drop [[toad's legs]] despite not being toads.
